note: TestRFC2865RetransmitRepeatsIdentifierAuthenticatorAndSourcePort drives a real retransmit through Client.Exchange (first datagram unanswered), asserts the attribute octets unchanged first, then byte-compares the Identifier, all 16 Request Authenticator octets and the source addr:port of every retransmit against the first. A client that re-encoded with a new ID or authenticator, or opened a new socket, goes red. The {single-polarity: positive} annotation holds: a same-ID MUST has no inbound input to refuse. TestClientRetransmit remains a floor assertion.
